Name: Show NPCs Name
Author: samable
Description:
[size=3]Show NPCs and players names above their heads, especially suitable for multiplayer gaming.
[/size]
[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3][i](Optional)[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]Tips[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]If you installed [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]: The mod settings interface supports both English and Chinese.[/size]
[*][b][size=3]Due to insufficient conditions, it has not been tested whether it can work normally in the local split-screen mode.[/size][/b]
[/list][size=3]

---

在NPC或玩家头顶显示名字，适合多人游戏使用。
[/size]

[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Fix BUG:
- When playing multiplayer games, the name of the console is displayed incorrectly in yellow.
- The Mosters and Junimos name is displayed incorrectly.

Add:
- The visibility of pets(including horses) name can be controlled.
